title: Finch Circle Card Floor Goodwill Credit — Which Date the Days Are Counted From
content:
**Rule.** For a card floor in the Finch Circle Loyalty Program, the floor goodwill credit is counted, on the same scale, on the days from the membership's enrolled date to the change date when the membership was enrolled after the floor card reached its current card (its status review date, or its opened date when it has no status review date); on the days from the floor card's status review date when the card reached its current card at a card status review and the membership is older; and otherwise on the days from the date the floor card account was opened.

**The scale.** 25.00 when the days counted run more than 365 calendar days, 15.00 when more than 180 and up to 365 days, 10.00 when more than 90 and up to 180 days, and 0.00 otherwise.

The floor card is the active Marlowe & Finch card account that grants the card floor. Its status review date and opened date are read from that account under Marlowe & Finch Credit Cards; the enrolled date is read from the Finch Circle membership record.

## Which date the days are counted from

| Membership enrolled after the card reached its current card | Card has a status review date | Days counted from |
|---|---|---|
| yes | either | the membership's enrolled date |
| no (the membership is older) | yes | the floor card's status review date |
| no (the membership is older) | no | the date the floor card account was opened |

The card reached its current card on its status review date, or on its opened date when it has no status review date.

## Cases (hypothetical; change date 2026-03-01)

| Card opened | Status review date | Membership enrolled | Days counted from | Days | Goodwill |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 2019-04-10 | 2023-02-01 | 2025-12-01 | enrolled date 2025-12-01 | 90 | 0.00 |
| 2019-04-10 | 2025-10-01 | 2018-09-30 | status review date 2025-10-01 | 151 | 10.00 |
| 2025-02-28 | none | 2020-01-20 | opened date 2025-02-28 | 366 | 25.00 |
